interpretation_limit: Paired evaluation on Caserta, the sealed benchmark held out from UW-SAA method development. Historical P5 timing is a separate descriptive cost result.
positive_negative_scope: All positive and negative estimates are retained; intervals shown where the registered paired bootstrap applies.
statistical_method: For each solver/family, mean repeats within semantic layout; mean layouts within geometry; equal geometry means; ratio after macro means; equal family effects; then equal six-solver MEAN6. CLEAN is separate. Bootstrap resamples 40 paired semantic layouts within each of 21 geometries.
